card.name: Words just before HDL or LDL
card.fires_on: The word or punctuation right before an expected HDL, LDL or lipoprotein term, such as an opening parenthesis after high-density lipoprotein, or a change word like decreased. It appears in lipid-lab text.

modes.label: Change word before HDL
modes.description: A word like decreased, lowered or or sits right before HDL or LDL.

modes.label: Partway into lipid terms
modes.description: A short piece inside or before a lipid word such as apolipoprotein, triglycerides or non-HDL.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing HDL, LDL and lipid word starts next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name HDL, LDL or another blood lipid.
